name: Rose
source:
A newcomer to the pleasure house Red Velvet, Dizzy has been training with the goal of becoming a worthy assistant to Madam Vera.

Dizzy appears to hold the [url=/c165977]Officer[/url] in high regard due to his military exploits and personal reputation. This interest however is more than platonic, and takes the form of love-at-first-sight.

[spoiler]Dizzy was identified as an exceptionally intelligent child while she was growing up in one of Muiran's orphanages. Various institutions have approached her with promises of scholarship and apprenticeships. But the young girl chose a path that would define her being for the rest of her live.

Dizzy’s real name is Rose, family name unknown. But it must have meant something for her to reveal it to the Officer. Perhaps a gesture of trust and love?

A new fire of conflict has ignited on Elysium, with Dizzy serving as the trigger. She set off the bomb that will change the fate of many. But she will never see the consequences of her action, as she perished in the flame of her own making, taking all her secrets with her.

Rose and [url=/c166112]Hilde[/url] are sisters in every way but blood. The inseparable duo were hand-picked to be trained as Judges when they were still young. Rose completed her training and graduated by the age of sixteen, making her the youngest in the history of the bureau. Three months before the Day of Infamy, Rose went off-grid and Hilde has been searching for her since.[/spoiler]

[In-Game Description]
